name: Overloaded
title: Overloaded
text:
The explosion causes significant knockback. Overloaded DMG is also considered a Blunt Attack, and can therefore trigger Shatter and is more effective at damaging certain enemy shields.
Overloaded does not apply Pyro to targets hit, and therefore cannot trigger further elemental reactions.
## Damage
Note that one target can only take 1 instance of Overloaded DMG every 0.5 seconds from the same attacker, as limited by the Damage Sequence. Additionally, multiple Overloaded reactions triggered on the same target within 0.1 seconds can only produce DMG once, regardless of the source.
